cases.oracle: unavailable; no counter wrap, callback, event or state change. Fixture injection is test-only, never a product API.

cases.oracle: Every successful read equals complete old or new checkpoint; unavailable while a recovery barrier is active is allowed; no partial pair, mixed revision, missing event or mismatched provenance.

cases.oracle: Definite refusal, zero success result; old facts/revision/events remain complete through repeated recovery; failure evidence retained where recovery cannot finish.

cases.action: Kill writer after durable decision before ack; reopen, recover twice; also kill during recovery and reopen
cases.oracle: No caller success is claimed for killed process; complete new state with exactly one increment/event after recovery, idempotent restart, no duplicated event or partial state.

cases.action: Inject ambiguous publication/parent-sync failure after data publication but before confirmed durability
cases.oracle: commit_outcome_unknown with no success result, latched unavailable until reconciliation; preserve original evidence; recovery returns old or new whole checkpoint according to durable decision, never automatic retry.

cases.action: Checkpoint concurrently with writes; deliberately corrupt journal gap, duplicate/tail overwrite, scope, revision or changed-ID ordering in a stopped synthetic store
cases.oracle: Coherent snapshot/event endpoint for valid reads; malformed history refuses storage_error, never truncated/repaired; Update cannot overwrite old events.

cases.oracle: Elements and changed IDs sorted bytewise; provenance sorted path, events ascending; nested stored order and null/empty distinctions preserved exactly; canonical bytes match.

cases.oracle: At-bound valid data accepted; one-over payload_too_large for byte limits or invalid_snapshot for count; no partial result, truncation, commit, event or revision advance on refusal.

cases.oracle: Exactly one factory opened only after read-only preflight and authority readiness; invalid config no storage/listener I/O; failure no fallback; readiness is not production admission.

cases.oracle: Transport refusal and reconcile/recovery guidance; no local FS/DB opens, board process start, fallback or automatic write retry; client contains no backend dependency.
